# Required GitHub status-check names. Each must be a job `name:` in a workflow
# that runs on pull_request (ci.yml, ship-loop.yml).
# scripts/gates/check-required-ci-jobs.sh fails a PR when this list drifts.
# GitHub treats a skipped required check as passing, so nothing here may be
# path-filtered or conditional on a pull request.
Lint
Type Check
Unit Tests
Integration Tests (1/2)
Integration Tests (2/2)
Gate Self Tests
Ship loop
